solutionSearchEvidence: Current Browser gameplay directly owns each live draw pile as players[].deck and mutates it only by authoritative deck shifts/refill in the inspected current paths.
Current viewer-safe core unnecessarily requires secret remainingCardIds even when the consumer only needs authoritative total plus viewer-authorized known identities.
Using public played-card history alone is rejected because cards leave the draw pile at draw/refill time, not at later play/reveal time.
Count-only authority lets the later live consumer pass players[].deck.length while keeping identities/order outside the presentation boundary.
